matches.anchor: Amount must be a positive number greater than zero, with no more than two digits after the decimal point. Blank, zero, negative, non-numeric, and over-precision values must be rejected
matches.symptom: amount 0 and negative amounts are accepted (201, completed transaction); negative moves money in reverse

matches.anchor: The amount must not exceed the source account's available balance. If funds are insufficient, the transfer must be rejected, both balances must remain unchanged
matches.symptom: overdraft transfer succeeds; checking balance goes negative

matches.anchor: The start and end dates are inclusive. A transaction occurring on either boundary date must be included
matches.symptom: end date is exclusive: start=end=2025-02-14 returns 0 rows; Jan 1-Jan 18 omits the Jan 18 transaction

matches.anchor: Each row shows date and time, description or memo, transaction type, amount, status, and relevant account
matches.symptom: pending/failed rows show 'No change: $0.00' instead of the transaction amount

matches.anchor: Logging out returns the user to the landing page
A profile view displays only synthetic demo-customer details, such as display name and a masked email address
